The message is:

feat(web): drive Pi over its RPC mode instead of the pi-acp bridge

Ajax Chat now runs Pi as `pi --mode rpc -na [--session <id>]` and speaks its
JSONL RPC protocol directly. Cursor, Codex and Claude stay on ACP.

- adapters: Pi RPC process, handshake, session driver, record mapper and
  PiRpcClient, behind a SessionClient enum (Acp | Pi) that the web session
  slot and spawn path now use; AcpEventSource lets the drain accept either
- restore is fail-closed: a different session id from Pi is a typed
  `ACP restore unavailable` error; model/thinking pins apply through
  set_model / set_thinking_level; usage comes from get_session_stats
- core: HarnessTransport on the launch table (Pi = PiRpc), doctor reports
  `rpc:pi`; the Pi model catalog is read from the RPC handshake
- docs: web-cockpit, web-session-behavior and README describe the transport
- tests use a fake Pi child; four pi-acp expectations were updated, and a few
  session_client tests were adjusted for the new usage/pin behavior
